name: Amanpuri
positioning: Beachfront Aman resort of pavilions and villas on Pansea Beach in Phuket, the first Aman resort
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront pavilion or villa stay on Phuket's Andaman Sea coast
Families, with a kids' pool-and-activity centre and multi-bedroom villas

facts.text: Amanpuri shares Pansea Beach with The Surin resort next door.
Buabok is the main restaurant and serves southern Thai dishes.
Arva specializes in southern Italian home-cooking.
The wellness centre has 12 treatment rooms.
Amanpuri has a Muay Thai boxing ring.
Amanpuri has floodlit tennis courts where lessons can be booked.
The Eco-Beach Discovery Centre has a skateboarding ramp, climbing wall and aquarium.
Amanpuri's Aman 35 powerboat gives access to islands including Phi Phi, Similan and Phang Nga Bay.
Villa guests have a dedicated Villa Host and personal Thai chef.
Round-trip airport transfers from Phuket International Airport are included for stays of three nights and more.

highlights.text: Amanpuri was the first Aman resort.
Ed Tuttle designed the Thai temple-like pavilions in 1988.
The Ocean Platform Sunset Experience takes guests to a private island platform in the Andaman Sea.
Nama serves omakase menus from behind a hinoki wood counter designed by Kengo Kuma.
Amanpuri's pavilions sit on the hillside of a former coconut plantation site by the Andaman Sea.

considerations.text: Steep hills and many stairs make getting around Amanpuri a challenge.
The Ocean Platform Experience is available from November to March.
WhataHotel notes a secluded location with limited nearby dining options.
